quest.title: Business Acumen From the Spina
quest.description: After all is set, you and Paimon turn your attention to learning how to run the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland under Navia's guidance...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's do this.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: It's time, dear partner and Paimon, for us to turn our attention to the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: As I mentioned, the park was started up by enthusiasts, who brought in the Spina di Rosula to handle the planning, construction, and operations.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Of course, enthusiasts aren't typically all-around experts. They usually stick to designing the event booths.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: We, for our part, handle long-term operations and develop standardized strategy guides for the different activities.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Long-term operations, strategy... It all sounds so complicated!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We spend most of our time adventuring, and we barely have any experience running a stall... Do you think we can handle this?

choices.text: Not every big boss went to business school, y'know!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: That's more like it! You've seen it all before, haven't you, partner? I'd even go as far as to say you've shaped some of Teyvat's biggest business ventures!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Anyway! First things first, let's get an overview of how the whole festival's gonna be run...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ah, Paimon thinks she just about gets it. How do you feel about it, {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: Haha, sounds right up my alley!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep! C'mon, we can do this!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, you mentioned "standardized strategy guides" just now... Does that mean there are non-standard ways to take part too?

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Of course! Film and entertainment mean different things to different people, and there's gonna be a wide range of exciting activities for people to try out.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: If we're not careful, some visitors might wander off and end up getting in trouble...

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: And others might pick up dangerous props by mistake.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: To avoid confusion, we need to create a "standardized strategy guide" for each activity. Just think of it like a walkthrough!

choices.text: I see, you want me to be your test player.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, if we're the first ones to test out the activities, who knows what surprises there could be waiting for us...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But if we hit a tough spot, we'll just have to rely on our skills to carry us through!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Hopefully it goes without saying that I'd never put you in danger, partner. I carefully checked all the existing activities before you arrived, and I can assure you that they're all perfectly safe.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: I also wanted you to experience the activities before anyone else gets to. It'll be fun! Plus, we'd like to hear your thoughts and suggestions!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, those are two things Navia is best at — making people feel safe, and having fun!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Great. Well, I can't wait to hear what you think! Your input is super important to us.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Alright then, let's start with Eclectic Escapades and put our first guide together!

choices.text: I get it, you want me to set the benchmark.
Wow... Guess we'll learn on the job!
We've done plenty of big business ourselves!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Both of you seem even more excited than before. Looks like your first trial run didn't disappoint!

choices.text: The challenge format is super easy to get into!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon hasn't actually watched that many films, but after trying it out... she might just be hooked! We should check out the film that it's based on!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Great job, Paimon! That's exactly what our enthusiast friends were hoping you'd say.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: They'd be beyond delighted to hear that visitors are curious about the films that inspired these attractions!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Some have even been willing to contribute extra funds out of their own pockets — where budgets have allowed, of course.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Out of their own pockets...?

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: That's right! While the Spina di Rosula covers the cost of basic booth materials and rental fees, many fans have personally funded promotional materials and related merchandise.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: The cost of the booth itself isn't their main expense. Some of them have already started designing spin-off products inspired by film characters.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Take our official mascot, Surintendante Chevalmarin, for instance. She won second place in the last "Most Popular Character" poll for the comic film category, and was even dubbed "the pinnacle of round, bouncy cuteness."

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Many people have expressed interest in designing cushions based on her image, using the highest quality fabrics and hiring the most skilled artisans to mass-produce them...

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: These cushions will officially go on sale at the next convention alongside lots of similar products!

choices.text: Now that you mention it, I kinda want one too...

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Sounds irresistible, right? Plus, as Surintendante Chevalmarin's guardian and official image rights agent, Furina will receive sixty percent of the sales revenue!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: After all, the fans are doing this voluntarily — not for profit, but to promote Surintendante Chevalmarin's adorable image.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: The more Mora that ends up in Furina's purse, the better Surintendante Chevalmarin's meals will be — and who wouldn't be happy to hear that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, Paimon likes the sound of that! Everyone working hard for something they all love, without worrying about profit!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Still, we can't just ignore Mora completely. Whether it's fan creations or official commercial projects, some level of financial balance is still necessary.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: The same logic applies to the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland taken as a whole.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Once we've finished the standardized strategy guides, our attractions can officially be opened to the public. But we can't take personal charge of the ticketing process.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: There's plenty of work to do at the various booths, and the park itself is a work in progress. We'll need to assign dedicated employees to maintain and manage each attraction...

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: There's a recruitment section on the park's bulletin board. We've received many applications, and each candidate has their strengths. Our job is to match the best candidates to each attraction based on their overall performance.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Once assigned, the staff will keep the attractions running, ensuring a continuous revenue stream!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, so we've suddenly gone from being playtesters to... Heads of Human Resources? That's definitely a first for us...

choices.text: I have very high standards when it comes to reviewing resumes!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Just don't hold everyone up to your own standards, okay? You can't expect everyone else to be as capable as you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, time to review some resumes! Fingers crossed, we'll get some exceptional candidates!

choices.text: I'll make an awesome boss.
Shouldn't Furina be getting a sizable cut?

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Don't worry, as Surintendante Chevalmarin's guardian and official image rights agent, Furina's already getting sixty percent of the sales revenue!

choices.text: And it ties in perfectly with the film theme.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like this particular employee is really getting into their role...

choices.text: Wishing them success on the job!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Hahaha, you're both doing great. You sound more like bosses than I do!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: In any case, with this, the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland is now officially open!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Running a theme park is a long-term project. You won't make much if you try and rush it.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: We're just about done with our current work setup, so let's take a short break and wait for this cycle's revenue report to come in.

choices.text: I'll be monitoring their attendance closely!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Alright then. Time to try out Eclectic Escapades. I'll leave the strategy guide to you guys!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Well, the numbers might not look that impressive, but given that we're just getting the ball rolling, I'd say that wasn't a bad start!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Building on this momentum, we must consider rolling out more unique business strategies during the next cycle!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: To draw in the crowds, I've invited one of Fontaine's very own celebrity chefs — my good friend Escoffier!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: She'll be "performing" right here in the amusement park's restaurant. On that note, let's go catch up with her!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So is the restaurant part of our business strategy too? There are so many layers to this operation...

talks.objective: Choose a theme dish to make

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: When reviewing resumes, pay attention to each applicant's area of expertise!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: I've refined the sauce for these Barbeque Ribs. It's a richer flavor than the classic version, but not at all greasy.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: The Mint extract in the seasoning leaves a refreshing aftertaste — perfect for indulging yourself after a fun-filled day.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: But if you ask me, I'd say the artisans need these more than the guests.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The artisans?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: As I'm sure you've noticed, this park isn't quite finished. A serving of these Barbeque Ribs should help the artisans replenish their strength much more quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: As their bosses, you have an obligation to provide meals for them. So why not invite them to dine here?

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Who knows, the morale boost might even improve their productivity.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Oh? If I recall correctly, you once served up some special Fish and Chips for the porters over at the Fleuve Cendre...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: For several days after, the workers were all incredibly efficient. They'd finish eight hours of work in just five, and then because they clocked out early, they'd come back completely refreshed the next day.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Then there's no time to lose. Go invite the artisans over while these ribs are still hot. I'll prepare some side dishes and desserts too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's a great idea! You really live up to your reputation, Escoffier!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like these theme dishes are gonna make a huge difference after all! We'll have to make sure we check in with you regularly!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You and Navia invite the artisans over, treating them to a delicious feast of special Barbeque Ribs...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Well, this cycle of operations sure got us off to a good start. On to the next one!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Whew... That should be everything. Looks like you've pretty much mastered how to run this park!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Have we really?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thinking about it... We have learned quite a lot, haven't we?

choices.text: Just goes to show how well Navia explained it all.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Not at all. I wouldn't say I taught you much. Your intuition's been guiding the way, mostly!

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: I imagine "long-term operations" sounded like a scary prospect the first time I mentioned it, huh?

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: But don't let that scare you! Just break things down into smaller steps and tackle them one at a time. Even if you're not a genius or naturally gifted, you'll get it done in the end!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, seeing her own progress has really got Paimon fired up! Actually, she's gonna jot your words of encouragement right down, hehe...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: From here on out, we'll be running the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland together — let's make it a big success!

choices.text: Couldn't have done it without Navia's guidance!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, it's you!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Ready to join the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland crew?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me get a few other things in order first.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: No problem. We'll be ready when you are!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Mmm...

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: The restaurant is up to standard, and the waterside location will make for a unique dining experience. The beautiful scenic reflections in the water create a stunning backdrop, lifting diners' spirits and allowing them to truly savor their meals.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Ingredients, check... Cooking utensils, check... Looks like we're ready to rumble.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there, Escoffier!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Oh! My employers are here.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: #The president of the Spina di Rosula, plus the famous {NICKNAME} and Paimon... I must say, you seem a bit overqualified to be running a film-themed amusement park.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I'd say that if anyone here was overqualified, it would be the former head chef of the Hotel Debord... Wherever you walk, the aroma of fine cuisine follows in your wake.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Ahem... Let's get back to business.

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: #I'm guessing you want {NICKNAME} to help me decide the theme dish for each cycle. Right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Theme dish"...?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: This is the business strategy I mentioned earlier — using Escoffier's top-tier dishes to attract more visitors to the park!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: But this isn't just about attracting visitors. Her culinary masterpieces will surely have other surprising effects!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Just imagine, Paimon, if all you needed was a single ticket to enjoy all the attractions and taste all the legendary food... Wouldn't you be tempted?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Th—Th—Th... Then Paimon'd come every single day...

choices.text: Do you do annual passes?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Now, here's the twist: To get the most out of this strategy, the menu can't be made public.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Based on research by a certain food branding consultant, many restaurants have started offering a special "Chef's Surprise" dish.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: So, give me some inspiration every few business cycles, and I'll decide on our next theme dish.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Now then, give me your hand.

choices.text: My... hand?

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Mm, a warm and energetic feel.

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Your hands are callused from wielding your sword, but still quite delicate. When you grasp its hilt, it's like you're holding the bow of a violin...

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: A sword, then... The theme this time shall be "strength."

response.speaker: Escoffier
response.text: Alright! Let's find out what "strength" looks like in gastronomical form...

choices.text: I had no idea inspiration could be physically transferred...
I'd find a way to live here!

dialogues.speaker: Escoffier
dialogues.text: Alright! Let's find out what "strength" looks like in gastronomical form...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Aha! The essence of Escoffier's classic improvisational method — "mystery dishes inspired by key ingredients," as she puts it!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Now that everything's going smoothly, it's about time we upgraded our facilities!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The artisans are pumped and ready to roll thanks to that theme dish!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: And perfect timing, too! Let's take this chance to take the facilities of our Eclectic Escapades to the next level.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: As you can see, our Fantasyland's a bit like a sugar-free macaron right now... Several areas are still under construction.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: The Spina's only been able to hire a limited number of craftsmen. Besides, we don't have enough experience to handle multiple projects simultaneously.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: That's why I chose to adopt a time slot-based planning method, so we can focus on specific tasks during each designated period.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Upgrading facilities, expanding the venue, hiring staff... All of this requires funds and time slots to accomplish.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: So it's our job to allocate precious time slots in each business cycle to the most worthwhile tasks.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: As we attract more guests and earn money to add to our funds, we'll also be able to work more efficiently...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Which will allow us to divide each cycle into finer time slots, which will let us get more done!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... we'll be limited in the decisions we can make and tasks we can focus on within each time period.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Which means we have to use our limited actions and Mora to earn even more Mora!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kinda like playing chess or cards, then. Cooking up a strategy in advance is gonna be key.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We should be able to attract more customers by upgrading this stall, don'cha think?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: That's right! Based on my business experience with the Spina di Rosula, I've quantified the "service value" to help you intuitively understand how satisfied customers are with each stall.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: An attraction will reach its ideal revenue only when its "service value" meets customer expectations. As we improve and expand our facilities, expectations will also increase accordingly.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: When that happens, we can deploy more capable employees, or invest funds in training to enhance our employees' skills!
